issues: Grey stage, a 96px stem and small white pills: the sentence was a strip across the top with two thirds of the frame empty and no key visual
All six beats were an even 21f, one flat metronome; there was no sense of slowing to a stop and the conclusion had no step-up over the list
White pills with grey text and indigo icons sat at almost the same value as the background, leaving the accent colour nowhere to land
Real product names (Drive, Slack) were written into the pills, and the payoff was a same-colour 'do it all.'
changes: Midnight look (navy, electric blue, cyan): a two-line left-aligned poster with a 176px/800 stem pinned on line one and a full-width 'fill in the blank' rule as the slot on line two, a ⌘K keycap at its end marking it as an AI command bar
Pills rebuilt as dark glass capsules (156px tall, 90px text, 108px electric-blue gradient icon tile) with lift-dependent shadows, drum flips and speed-based vertical motion blur
Accelerating rhythm: six beats shrinking from 28 to 16f, like a slot machine speeding up before it stops; duration 200 to 205f with a 48f hold on the full sentence

Payoff: the last pill flies off first and 'do it all.' rises from behind it at the stem's exact size and weight with a back overshoot, in a blue-to-cyan gradient; the blank rule then lights left to right with one bloom behind the slot
Copy uses a fictional brand, Relay, and generic action phrases of 14 to 16 characters so the slot width stays steady; real product names removed
